change_control: Any text/field change of an existing requirement bumps its per-requirement version and the set version (minor for additions, major for removals/semantic changes); ids are never reused. rtm.check_change_control() enforces this against the recorded baseline_digest.

requirements.title: Pool construction
requirements.text: The Pool SHALL reject construction unless 0 <= min_nodes <= max_nodes and per_node >= 1 and lease_ttl >= 1 are ints (bool rejected), raising ValueError.
requirements.postconditions: pool exists with validated bounds or no object is created

requirements.title: Hard upper bound
requirements.text: After every tick the Pool SHALL contain at most max_nodes nodes, for any finite non-negative demand including arbitrarily large integers.

requirements.title: Demand-following target
requirements.text: Tick SHALL compute target = max(min_nodes, min(max_nodes, ceil(demand/per_node))) and, absent busy surplus, SHALL resize the pool to exactly target.
requirements.postconditions: size == target when busy nodes <= target

requirements.title: Busy node safety
requirements.text: Tick SHALL NOT reclaim a node whose busy flag is true, regardless of lease expiry or surplus.
requirements.postconditions: busy node still present after tick

requirements.title: Busy lease renewal
requirements.text: Tick SHALL renew the lease of every busy node to now + lease_ttl and report it in renewed.
requirements.postconditions: expires == now + lease_ttl; id in renewed

requirements.title: Idle reclamation
requirements.text: Tick SHALL reclaim an idle node whose lease expired (expires <= now) or that is surplus to target, and report it in reclaimed.

requirements.title: Lease on admission
requirements.text: Every node added by tick SHALL be admitted with a lease expiring at now + lease_ttl and busy false.
requirements.postconditions: new node state == {expires: now+ttl, busy: false}

requirements.title: Transactional tick
requirements.text: A tick that raises SHALL leave nodes, node_hours and the time watermark unchanged (no partial mutation).

requirements.title: Input rejection
requirements.text: Tick SHALL reject NaN/Inf, booleans, negative demand, negative elapsed_hours and a regressing now with ValueError (terminal, non-retryable for the same input).

requirements.title: Restored-state validation
requirements.text: Tick SHALL raise PoolInvariantError when externally modified state has more than max_nodes nodes or malformed node records.

requirements.title: Node-hour accounting
requirements.text: Tick SHALL add len(nodes_before_tick) * elapsed_hours to node_hours.
requirements.postconditions: node_hours increases by pre-tick size * elapsed_hours

requirements.title: Collision-free identifiers
requirements.text: Tick SHALL never assign a node id already present in the pool, including after restore of arbitrary ids.

requirements.title: Node lifecycle
requirements.text: A node SHALL move only through ABSENT -> LEASED_IDLE (admission) <-> LEASED_BUSY (set_busy) and LEASED_IDLE -> ABSENT (reclaim); LEASED_BUSY -> ABSENT is illegal.

requirements.title: Determinism
requirements.text: Given identical constructor arguments and an identical sequence of (now, demand, elapsed_hours, set_busy) calls, the Pool SHALL produce identical TickResults and state.

requirements.title: Bounded work
requirements.text: Tick SHALL complete in O(max_nodes + len(nodes)) work independent of the magnitude of demand.
requirements.postconditions: tick with demand 10**100 completes like demand max_nodes*per_node

requirements.title: Multi-context applicability
requirements.text: The same Pool semantics SHALL apply in cloud, datacenter, near-edge and far-edge placements; placement differences SHALL be expressed only in topology (component 09), never in pool logic.
requirements.postconditions: validator accepts all tiers; model has no tier input

requirements.title: Outcome semantics
requirements.text: Overlay results SHALL use core.Outcome: SUCCESS, PARTIAL, DEGRADED, RETRYABLE_FAILURE, TERMINAL_FAILURE, OPERATOR_REQUIRED, BLOCKED; unknown codes SHALL degrade to OPERATOR_REQUIRED.

requirements.title: Concurrency
requirements.text: Pool SHALL be treated as single-writer; concurrent callers SHALL use a lock-protected wrapper (component 58).
